paper_title: Incorporating Domain Knowledge into Materials Tokenization
caption: Comparison of Micro-F1 scores for ChemDataExtractor and MatDetector across different values.
model_annotation:
The plot illustrates the Micro-F1 score for two methods, MatDetector and ChemDataExtractor, across a range of lambda values. The x-axis is labeled “λ value” and displays values from “w/o” to 3, with tick labels at 0.1 intervals from 0.1 to 3. The x-axis scale is not clearly defined but appears to be linear. The y-axis is labeled “Micro-F1 Score (%)” and ranges from 52 to 58, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 1. 

The MatDetector (ours) method is represented by a solid, pink line with circular markers. Starting at a value of approximately 52.8 at “w/o”, this line increases to a peak of 57.6 at 0.6 and then declines to approximately 53.4 at 3. The ChemDataExtractor method is represented by a dashed, dark blue line with square markers. This line begins at approximately 52.2 at “w/o”, declines to 51.8 at 0.2, then increases to around 54.6 at 3.
